kpis.label: One-time visitors
kpis.description: Patients seen this period whose only visit on record is this one (they have not returned yet). One-time visitors + Returning patients = Total patients.

kpis.label: Returning patients
kpis.description: Patients seen this period who have more than one visit on record: they came back.

kpis.label: Avg patient age
kpis.description: Approximate: the mean age of the patients seen this period (patients without a date of birth excluded).

kpis.label: ABHA linked
kpis.description: Share of patients seen who have an ABHA (national health ID) linked.

kpis.label: Contactable
kpis.description: Share of patients seen with a mobile number or email on file: reachable for recalls and campaigns.

kpis.label: Top blood group
kpis.description: The most common recorded blood group among patients seen this period (31 patients). Patients without a recorded group are not counted.
